note: Background music, instrumental, picked by Jin on 2026-10-16 from two takes per slot. Files live in assets/music/<id>.mp3, all loudness-matched to -14 LUFS (true peak -1 dB). Jin then switched menu_select to an arcade Tarantella Napoletana and results to a Felicità-spirit instrumental (both ElevenLabs Music direct); the earlier arcade-rock versions are kept in assets/music/alt/. fight_nonna and fight_peacock were made with ElevenLabs Music directly; fight_martino with ElevenLabs Music v2.5 on fal.ai, in the style of the reference track Battita di Ferro. Tracks with loop=true are cut on a bar boundary with a 1 s crossfade of the tail into the head, so play them with loop on and no gap; results plays once.

tracks.prompt: The traditional Neapolitan folk dance Tarantella Napoletana, its famous fast melody, arranged as a retro arcade video game menu theme, instrumental, loopable. Lively 6/8 at 150 bpm, melody on accordion and mandolin doubled by a bright chiptune square-wave lead, tambourine and punchy electronic drums, bouncing bass, hand claps, cheerful and frantic, A minor to A major, steady energy from the first bar, no intro, no fade out, no vocals.
tracks.edit: arcade arrangement of the traditional Tarantella Napoletana (public domain), cut to a seamless loop

tracks.prompt: Boss battle music for a video game, loopable, instrumental. An angry Italian grandmother chases heroes around a farm kitchen: frantic tarantella rhythm, accordion and mandolin lead, driving rock drums and distorted bass, brass stabs, clattering pots as percussion accents. Comic but intense, bright and energetic. D minor, 144 bpm, full energy from the first bar, no intro, no fade out, no vocals.

Boss battle music for a video game, loopable, instrumental. A vain peacock shows off in hazelnut woods: flamboyant glam rock with a theatrical, show-off feel, big brass fanfares, electric guitar riff, mandolin flourishes, dramatic timpani rolls, bright and pompous. D minor, 144 bpm, driving energy from the first bar, no intro, no fade out, no vocals.

Instrumental final boss battle theme for a retro arcade fighting game: a little dog turned into a huge monster by AI glasses, fought in Venice. The most epic track of the game. Modern hi-fi chiptune fused with J-rock and orchestral elements, 175 BPM, 4/4. Relentless 16th-note synth bass, heavy compressed drums with big fills, heavy distorted guitars, supersaw walls, frantic chiptune arpeggios, glitchy digital synth textures for the AI glasses. Venetian drama: church organ, choir pads, mandolin tremolo, timpani. Dark urgent minor-key sections building to a heroic, triumphant major-key chorus, an intense shred synth solo. Maximum energy, designed to loop seamlessly, no fade out.
tracks.edit: cut from the 146 s take to a 135 s seamless loop

tracks.prompt: Early 1980s Italian pop love duet hit, instrumental karaoke backing track, in the spirit of a joyful Sanremo festival winner. Mid-tempo 112 bpm, gentle disco-pop drums, warm bouncy bass, bright synth strings, acoustic guitar strums, a sweet very catchy whistle-able chorus melody played by synth lead and mandolin, hand claps, major key, pure happiness, sunny Italian summer, no vocals, clean ending.
tracks.edit: original instrumental in the spirit of Felicità (Al Bano and Romina Power); not the real recording
